# `⊣` — Left

Keys: `Alt-;`. Ranks: `∞` monadic, `∞ ∞` dyadic

`⊣Y` returns `Y`.

```bpl
⊣1 2               ⍝ 1 2
```

`X⊣Y` returns `X`. Both arguments evaluate.

```bpl
1 2⊣3 4            ⍝ 1 2
```

See [trains](parentheses.qmd).

## Inverse

`⊣⁻¹` is `⊣`. `X ⊣⁻¹ Y` is `Y`, which must match `X`.

```bpl
3 ⊣⁻¹ 3   ⍝ 3
```
